name: GhostCursor-TS-TW
title: Ghost Cursor Trail
blurb: A luminous trail that follows your cursor and fades when you stop moving.
description: Three.js component rendering a procedurally animated cursor trail with bloom and film grain effects. The trail follows mouse movement with inertia-based momentum and configurable fade delay.
use_when: You want to add a subtle, premium interaction layer that rewards mouse movement across the entire page.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or when keyboard navigation is the primary input method.
a11y: Purely visual cursor tracking; no keyboard alternative or prefers-reduced-motion guard.
